option.name: --createstub
tip: Create type stub file(s) for import.

option.name: --dependencies
tip: Emit import dependency information.

option.name: --ignoreexternal
tip: Ignore external imports for --verifytypes.

option.name: --level
tip: Minimum diagnostic level (error or warning).
Possible values: error, warning

option.name: --outputjson
tip: Output results in JSON format.

option.name: --project
tip: Use the configuration file at this location.

option.name: --pythonpath
tip: Path to the Python interpreter.

option.name: --pythonplatform
tip: Analyze for a specific platform (Darwin, Linux, Windows, iOS, Android).
Possible values: Darwin, Linux, Windows, iOS, Android

option.name: --pythonversion
tip: Analyze for a specific version (3.3, 3.4, etc.).

option.name: --skipunannotated
tip: Skip analysis of functions with no type annotations.

option.name: --stats
tip: Print detailed performance stats.

option.name: --threads
tip: Use separate threads to parallelize type checking.

option.name: --typeshedpath
tip: Use typeshed type stubs at this location.

option.name: --venvpath
tip: Directory that contains virtual environments.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Emit verbose diagnostics.

option.name: --verifytypes
tip: Verify type completeness of a py.typed package.

option.name: --version
tip: Print Pyright version and exit.

option.name: --warnings
tip: Use exit code of 1 if warnings are reported.

option.name: --watch
tip: Continue to run and watch for changes.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Show this help message.
